intro_description: Uniwave Logistics Co., Ltd. was established in March 2025, specializing in providing international freight forwarding, transportation, and logistics services, with the slogan “Ship Smart – Move Fast”. Uniwave aims to optimize supply chains for Vietnamese and international businesses through modern transportation systems, transparent processes, and professional services. We take pride in being a trusted partner, accompanying customers in their journey to expand their goods to Southeast Asian and global markets.
vision_description: To become the leading logistics company in Southeast Asia, pioneering the application of technology to connect global trade and create sustainable value for customers.
mission_description: Our mission is to provide smart, flexible, and transparent logistics solutions to optimally meet transportation needs in the digital era. We continuously strive to reduce costs, shorten delivery times, and enhance competitiveness for Vietnamese businesses. Additionally, we aim to build a global goods connectivity network, strongly supporting import-export processes and promoting international economic integration.
